role: Pre-registered v30 single fixed-point independent negative evaluation; not full goal acceptance
event_policy: Existing float64 five-score convolution; >= threshold; rising latch, rearm below half threshold, 67-step refractory; reset between speakers; count all events including startup
exposure_policy: Original waveform seconds only; exclude inserted utterance gaps and final alignment padding
protocol: Commit and push this record and evaluator before scoring. Complete all 73 streams once, irrespective of early failures. Never tune the threshold/model, discard events or retry a candidate based on these final scores. A failed fixed-point test is a failure; later candidates require fresh independent acceptance data. This set never becomes training data.
limits: Only this frozen LibriSpeech negative distribution. No independent positive recall, phonetic endpoint accuracy, TV/farfield coverage or MCU equivalence conclusion. Full goal remains incomplete even if the negative numerical bound passes.
